_comment: Clef-flash Index on the full 12,104-row DEV slice with every Index phase (S2 decide, S2c 32k arm on the 51 over-length rows, S2b native) on transformers' torch reference GDN (CLEF_GDN_PATH=reference, JOB_SPEC 4d). Same 32k handling as job-ftpnf (overlength_rows.json, SENS_MAX 32768, summarize.py substitute, edition 0.2.1) but substituted into THIS job's own reference decide results instead of job-sgihj's fast ones (ROWS=overlength cannot run on the reference: the runner refuses it, and its 12,053 other rows would stay fast). Caps: job-sgihj's measured fast Clef-flash index phase (19.48 min) x the 4x reference slowdown floor = 78 min expected; index cap 109 = 1.40x (rederive rule >= max(1.3x, 1.28x/0.95)). sens: 4x job-ftpnf's expected 3 = cap 12; native: 4x job-sgihj's 0.63 min. DEV only.
